name: ui-layouts-marquee
blurb: Content scrolls continuously in a loop, horizontally or vertically.
description: Duplicates children in a seamless scrolling marquee animation. Direction, duration, and pause-on-hover behavior are configurable.
use_when: Showcasing a rolling list of logos, testimonials, or news items without user action.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces where pause-on-hover cannot activate; content shorter than the viewport.
a11y: Animation is purely visual; no focus or keyboard interaction. Content is still readable outside the marquee.
